text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...I heard from my dad.
He said Festa hasn't had any motivation at all lately.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text: ...Not really. It's got nothing to do with you, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It does matter. Because my student
has such an anxious look on her face,
as if her precious treasure is about to disappear.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "That if I ran all-out, I'd end up losing sight of the precious treasure I worked so hard to find."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as I thought. You've gotten considerably stronger, haven't you?
The kids in class can't even hold a candle to you anymore."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
What you want is proof that you're alive.
That razor-thin moment where your heart leaps, pounds, and fills with pure excitement...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"That's why you're worried, right?
Afraid that you might never be able to get that again
in the world of racing."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Of course it won't disappear.
I haven't even stepped onto the stage yet.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Festa, you don't need to worry, I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: What you seek is definitely here at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: There are encounters out there that can satisfy the desires lurking deep within your heart.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—If it's there, I'm sure
I can truly "live."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Don't run away from knowing the answer.
Try it at least once first.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Sensei, I'm alive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The path you showed me was truly the one
that allowed me to thrive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (...I can hear the rush of blood coursing through the back of my head.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(It's the same as "always."
...And because it's the same, I can tell.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (What I am about to do now is—)
"If it's your gamble, I'll see it through with you to the very end."
"‘If it's your gamble, I'll see it through to the end with you.’"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (—That this is a gamble for me.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I have something to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If there's even a one-in-eight chance...
No matter the risk, as long as there is a reward beyond it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I want to take on that challenge.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Festa? And Trainer too?
Why did you come all the way out here again...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sensei. A long time ago, you told me
that people need hope to live, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So this time, I'm making sure
you can't run away from hope either, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Stay alive, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If your life is to run out this year,
then I will spend this entire year
becoming your hope.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I won't let 'em say "I wish I'd watched it."
I'll make 'em say they wanna watch, that they're gonna watch.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
After all, Nakayama Festa will run in the
Classic Triple Crown and unleash unknown potential!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! I shall perform with astonishing brilliance,
and everyone will pin their hopes upon me—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "Everyone will start to hope that winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is possible."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You too, teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Sensei. This is a gamble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I will toss a coin
right before your eyes."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And the result—remains unknown until you open your hand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you're so curious about the answer,
go see it for yourself with your own two eyes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"The moment these hands open.
The moment I step out into the world."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That fleeting desire you just felt to see the results...
That's what we call hope.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, saying hope keeps people alive is utter nonsense.
That has nothing to do with curing Sensei's illness."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you don't have the will to recover,
even curable things won't heal.
choice_data_list: We need to give them hope for that to happen.
We need to give them hope for that to happen.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Whoa,
so the goal is the Triple Crown route, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"We ended up going with your plan after all.
Though we can no longer afford the luxury of just 'gaining experience.'"
choice_data_list: You need to perform well enough to get plenty of screen time on TV.

text_block_list.text:
Public interest in the Triple Crown road is remarkably high.
Even if people miss the live broadcast on the day, race footage will undoubtedly be featured on various programs.
In other words, if she puts on a good performance in that race, it should reach her teacher in the hospital room in one way or another.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh. Don't read into me that much.
It makes me uncomfy."
choice_data_list: Won't you say I'm becoming someone you can count on?
Could you say I'm becoming someone you can count on?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Are you stupid?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's head back and train. You're the trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Raise me into a top-tier Umamusume
worthy of your bet.
“—The first challenge to face is the Satsuki Sho, the opening leg of the Classic Triple Crown.”
